subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: What durable shape should replace inline per-session `systemPromptReport` storage while preserving bootstrap warning dedupe and compatibility?
rationale: Current source intentionally persists the report for warning dedupe, while recent field data shows the full report now dominates retained session-store size; automation cannot choose that storage policy safely.

options.title: Persist Minimal Report State
options.body: Keep only small warning-dedupe fields in the session row and make bulky report sections diagnostic-only, transient, or recomputable.

options.title: Use Out-of-Line Report Blobs
options.body: Move large report payloads to content-addressed storage with compact refs in session rows, similar to skill prompt blobs.

options.title: Retain Inline Reports
options.body: Keep the current inline design and rely on pruning/capping, accepting duplicated prompt metadata in retained rows.

recommendation.title: Persist Minimal Report State
recommendation.body: Keep only small warning-dedupe fields in the session row and make bulky report sections diagnostic-only, transient, or recomputable.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the prompt-report feature and authored the adjacent prompt-blob mitigation, making him the strongest routing owner for the storage-policy choice.
